answer: Name: Karst-Cipher Periodic Attestation. 1) An applicant enters a secure underground karst chamber to eliminate remote relays and proves uniqueness before an in-person registrar. 2) The registrar runs a cipher on the subject's iris hash and binds it to a signed credential with a willow smartcard key. 3) Users must renew this key every 30 days at a cost of $15 per session. Total cost for N identities is $15 N per month. The mechanism fails if corrupt registrars issue multiple cards to one person.
